obligations.summary: Auto-renews for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal.
obligations.action_required: Decide whether to renew; if not, serve written non-renewal notice on Meridian before the notice date or the term auto-extends 12 months.
obligations.notes: Client indicated satisfaction at last QBR; renewal likely, but confirm pricing (see OBL-0002).

obligations.summary: Supplier may increase fees at renewal by up to CPI + 3% on 45 days written notice.
obligations.action_required: On receipt of any price-increase notice, verify the uplift does not exceed CPI + 3% and that 45 days notice was given.
obligations.notes: Watch for the notice to arrive ~45 days before renewal.

obligations.summary: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days written notice; a tail fee survives for 12 months.
obligations.action_required: If disengaging, serve 30 days notice and diarise the 12-month tail-fee exposure window from the termination date.
obligations.notes: Deal team weighing a switch of advisor; keep the notice mechanics ready.

obligations.summary: Supplier must maintain cyber-liability cover of not less than $10m and furnish a certificate of insurance annually.
obligations.action_required: Request and check the annual certificate of insurance; confirm cover is at least $10m and current.
obligations.notes: Last year's COI arrived late; chase proactively.

obligations.summary: Processor must delete or return all personal data within 30 days of any termination of the services.
obligations.action_required: On any termination, issue the deletion/return instruction and obtain written confirmation within 30 days.
obligations.notes: Contingent on termination; no diary date until a termination is triggered.

obligations.summary: Client must deliver a quarterly compliance attestation to the counterparty within 15 days of quarter-end.
obligations.action_required: Prepare and deliver the quarterly compliance attestation to Sterling within 15 days of quarter-end.

obligations.summary: Fixed 3-year term expiring 31 Dec 2026 with no auto-renewal; any renewal must be negotiated afresh.
obligations.action_required: If continuity is wanted, open renewal negotiations well before expiry — there is no automatic extension.
obligations.notes: No evergreen clause — expiry is hard.
